title: Bamboo roll, paper crane, paper lamp
supersedes: the legacy 26 px ring pack in ../source.json, which stays frozen and is not rebuilt

frozen_master.note: the owner-approved 02 painterly concept is immutable and untouched by this builder

crane.design: compact warm washi crane, rigid cotton cord, fixed brass support
crane.cut: old screw-eye above y=211 excluded; complete paper and remaining cord retained
crane.motion: whole pendant pivots at the fixed eye; no wing deformation

lamp.alpha_partition: a three-row band at y=265 over the upper link's own columns is removed, which disconnects the lower arch from the hook; each side is then the connected component seeded in the wood arm (static bracket: wall arm, support leg and upper link) and in the shade (moving lamp: lower arch, caps, paper and peg). That mask is hole-filled only to seed the components and to bound each cell: every cell's alpha is the master's AUTHORED alpha multiplied by its own partition coverage, so the link's genuine inner opening and the anti-aliased edges stay as transparent as the master authored them and no pixel is drawn by both parts. No luminance key and no opaque patch anywhere.
lamp.paper_test: moving coverage with luminance > 110 and a warm (r >= b) hue, hole-filled and eroded 1 px; dark recesses are never keyed out by luminance and the lamp layer keeps its full authored alpha

lamp_halo.method: warm circular two-lobe radial falloff, smooth to alpha zero
lamp_halo.motion: same hanging pivot, lampAngle and lampEnergy as the paper

atlas.alpha: straight RGBA; RGB zeroed exactly where alpha is zero

lightPlacement.derivation: measured paper centroid in logical root coordinates (553,883) source -> BR+(31.1,-87.2); bounded spill = max(3.9 x measured paper half-width 29.1, 2.2 insets) by max(1.9 x measured paper half-height 43.1, 1.7 insets), so the exp(-d^2) falloff crosses the 52 px ring and reaches about one inset into the client

offline_review_art.method: Offline actual atlas composition, not native capture

lamp-halo.shape: circular radial falloff with zero-alpha square edges

pre_approved_corners.normalisation: each measured piece maps its inner arm turn to exactly (52,52) logical inside the 104x104 canvas and fills both 52 px arms, with the two segment scales differing only by the piece's own arm asymmetry (anisotropy recorded per corner, all well inside the bounded 1.2)
pre_approved_corners.hardware: the sheet's own joinery and brass stay once per corner; nothing repeats along the rails

pre_approved_rails.cross_section_match: corner board channels/bevel profile with genuinely long outpainted grain; timber-only arm transitions; corner core/brass/alpha unchanged

timber_match.authority: corner-tl board profiles; genuinely long outpainted timber grain

pre_approved_rails.neutral_cut: 1088px long authored intervals, no hardware or short-crop quilting
pre_approved_rails.wrap: a connected minimum-error ownership cut through source stock; no crossfade

pre_approved_generation.retained_wood_attempts: earlier wood manifests are rejected generation history

pixel_units.source: source px exactly as delivered by the generator; actual dimensions are used, never the requested ones
pixel_units.components: 4 atlas px per logical px (corners, crane, lamp)
pixel_units.rails: 4 native atlas px per logical px; 256 logical px neutral repeats
pixel_units.legacy_cells: accepted bamboo/hook cells retain their authored pixels
pixel_units.lamp_halo: analytic radial RGBA at4 atlas px per logical px

pre_approved_generation.alpha: every generated master carries genuine near-opaque alpha with anti-aliased edges; alpha is preserved as authored, never re-keyed from luminance, and all resampling runs in premultiplied alpha so the decoder-visible garbage RGB under alpha 0 can never bleed into an edge. Where one master is split into parts (the lamp's static bracket and moving body) each cell's alpha is the master's authored alpha MULTIPLIED by that part's measured coverage, so a genuine transparent opening such as the hanging link's inner hole stays transparent instead of becoming an opaque patch of decoder RGB
pre_approved_generation.self_contained: the builder reads only the production copies listed here under design-faithful/source/ and never reads or re-copies the ignored scratch directory
